calls.task_title: Move Sample Airline flight to Friday

transcript.speaker: business
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Sample Airline. For new reservations, press 1. To change an existing trip, press 2.

transcript.speaker: business
transcript.text: Please say or enter your six-character confirmation code.

transcript.speaker: business
transcript.text: Thank you. All of our agents are helping other customers. Your wait time is more than 30 minutes.

transcript.speaker: business
transcript.text: Thank you for your patience. Please stay on the line and an agent will be with you shortly.

calls.task_title: Sample Clinic called back about Thursday

transcript.speaker: business
transcript.text: Hi, this is Sample Clinic returning a call about an appointment on Thursday.

transcript.speaker: hermes
transcript.text: Hi, this is Hermes, an AI assistant answering for the patient. Thanks for calling back. Is the 10:30 a.m. slot on Thursday still open?

transcript.speaker: business
transcript.text: Yes, it's confirmed for 10:30. Please arrive ten minutes early.

calls.summary: Sample Clinic confirmed Thursday at 10:30 a.m. Arrive ten minutes early.
